newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo ends dips against mark, weakened by franc.
newsitem.headline: Escudo ends dips against mark, weakened by franc.

text.p: The escudo closed weaker against the mark, reflecting the softer tone of the dollar and the retreat of the French franc, traders said.
Traders expect the currency to continue to mirror the performance of the franc which slipped after Prime Minister Lionel Jospin described the country's finances as being in serious condition.
The currency closed at 100.86/89 to the mark, down from its 100.66/69 opening. Traders said a further weakening of the franc could push the escudo beyond 101.00 on Friday.
